productor.loadAudioPrompt: Load an audio to use Brik.
productor.title: Brik
productor.subtitle: The agent listens, separates, mixes and masters on its own
productor.composerVerdictHint: Choose a route in the card and confirm.
productor.promptLabel: What do you want to achieve?
productor.promptPlaceholder: Ex: I want the voice up front and closer to the bass
productor.promptHint: Optional. Without instruction, the agent decides from the analysis.
productor.running: The agent is listening, separating and mixing. It may take several minutes.
productor.cancelled: You stopped waiting. The agent may continue working on the server.
productor.timeout: The agent took too long and we stopped waiting. The work may continue on the server.
productor.interrupted: The work was interrupted before completion.
productor.emptyResult: The job finished without a result. Try again.

narrative.route_master_only: Your audio already had a finished mix, so I went straight to mastering.
narrative.analyzed_original: I listened to the original: {lufs} LUFS integrated and {crest} dB of crest factor.
narrative.separated: I split the audio into {stems} stems so each one could be treated separately.
narrative.mix_clean: Quality control passed the mix on iteration {iteration}: nothing was left to fix.
narrative.mix_flagged: Quality control flagged {flags} issues on iteration {iteration}, and I fixed them.
narrative.knowledge_consulted: I checked the reference material and used {fragments} excerpts to back the decision.
narrative.master_from_mix: I mastered the mix: {lufs} LUFS, {peak} dBTP true peak and {crest} dB of crest factor.
narrative.master_from_original: I mastered the original: {lufs} LUFS, {peak} dBTP true peak and {crest} dB of crest factor.
narrative.master_correction_reverted: I tried a correction and threw it away: it flattened the dynamics by {crest_drop} dB. You keep the previous master.
narrative.master_dynamic_warning: The master lost {crest_drop} dB of dynamics compared to the input. I kept it because there was no better version.
narrative.step_failed: A step failed: {tool}. The rest of the process continued with what was already measured.

productor.stemsHint: Tap a stem to hear it on its own.
productor.metricsEmpty: The agent has not measured anything yet.
productor.audioEphemeral: No storage configured: the file lives on the server and does not survive a redeploy.

verdict.title: Brik's Verdict
verdict.subtitle: Brik analyzed your audio and proposes a route. The last word is yours.
verdict.deficienciesNone: The spectral balance is within the genre's target.
verdict.routeAutoDesc: Brik follows its verdict: mix if needed, master directly if not.
verdict.routeMixThenMasterDesc: The audio comes without mixing. It is separated into stems, balanced and then mastered.
verdict.routeMasterOnlyDesc: The audio already has a finished mix. It is mastered directly, without touching it.
verdict.analysisFailed: Could not complete the analysis. Try again.

chat.noHistory: No prior conversation. Write something to start.
chat.error: Could not send the message. Try again.
chat.escalateDescription: The agent will run the work in the background. You can keep chatting meanwhile.
